data_spec.denominator: Average Canadian survey respondent's planned budget CAD 530
data_spec.provenance: reported for original values; derived for computed historical values
data_spec.source_details: BCG 2026 Black Friday Consumer Study; Canada respondents n=1,000; detailed fieldwork dates not disclosed.

data_recipe: Normalize average planned budget in common currency and period.
Assign each segment to low/high affordability bands.
Compute dollar budget per segment and rounded share; reconcile rounding.
Order segments from higher spending to lower and render a descending waterfall.
Label total budget and group subtotals independently.
message_conditions: Values refer to same shoppers, purchase event, CAD unit and time horizon.
Five segment dollars sum to CAD 530, low segments to CAD 330 and high segments to CAD 200.
design_moves: Zero baseline and no synthetic values.
Direct value labels and documented emphasis.
Source and neutral themes via config.json.
limitations: Survey intention is not realized purchases.
Income/age mix and sample error are not disclosed in the graphic.
diff_notes: Original title/subtitle typography and dotted group brackets are simplified.
Original long-form category text shortened for legibility; no proprietary logo/font.
Percent shares sum to 99% because published figures are rounded.

training_pair.instruction: Use the public data in data.csv and design rules in config.json to render descending_waterfall; preserve reported/derived provenance and disclose limitations.
training_pair.response: Install requirements.txt, then run: python chart.py --data data.csv --config config.json --theme source --output source.png ; rerun --theme neutral --output neutral.png. The exact observed inputs and style mapping are in data.csv and config.json.
